notes.title: NEW DEMO
notes.notes:
Arcade, SpeedRun, Challenge? You are in the right place. Challenge the 26 levels of Mama Die and Retry. Mama is stronger than you.

[previewyoutube=1oscyEccX6w;full][/previewyoutube]

MAMA Die and Retry is an old school action platformer that offers a challenging experience through 26 levels and 4 bosses. Fight with a working class hero and discover new horizons filled with a lot of aliens and threats. Use your broom against them. Each time you die, you will retry.

MAMA Die And Retry sounds like an old arcade game : pixel art, retro music. All made with heart and soul.

[list]
[*] Multilayered parallax backgrounds, animations, WebGl effects, Particles give mordern touches.
[*] Detailed, colored, charming 80’s pixel art, 80’s Clothes, 80’s synths
[*] Don’t Kill, just pushback – Dodge, Avoid, perfect your skills
[*] Use Alien’s technology to improve yourself
[*] Slimes, Bees, Blobs, Bosses, a lots of fights and a lots of reasons to die…
[*] Run, Die, and Retry again and again.
[*] Less deaths, faster, try to do your best through 26 levels
[*] Brave 4 treacherous bosses…
[/list]

notes.title: Challenge Mama Die and Retry at IG Nation
notes.notes:
Come live the experience of video games, board games and independent role-playing games. Meet new game creators, journalists, influencers, streamers and speedrunners, all united under the same banner in a completely free event. This is the promise of the Indie Game Nation Fair which will be held on March 4 and 5, 2023 in Issy les Moulineaux!

[url=https://ig-nation.com/prix-du-public]Vote for Mama Die and Retry ![/url]

Come meet and challenge Mama Die and Retry !

Mama Die And Retry is an old-school platformer offering a real challenge through 26 levels and 4 bosses. The heroine comes from the working class and she will have to step out of her comfort zone to find planet Earth. The spirit of the game resides in an arcade vision all around an everyday heroine. The difficulty of the game is inspired by Mario The Lost Levels. Can you rise to the challenge?
